solution:
Calculation

The number of the AC that was sold by showroom B in the year 2014 = 92

The number of the AC that was sold by showroom D in the year 2016 = 100

The Percentage difference between the two:

⇒ (100 - 92)/100 × 100

⇒ 8%

**∴ The percentage is 8%.**
